failure_summary.description: Several answers had the right entity or concept but included extra wording or modifiers, used an expanded title, or omitted a needed location qualifier.
The agent returned a measured property instead of its source, a truth judgment instead of the clue's answer, or a title-holder instead of the entity requested by the relation.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directs the agent to provide a minimal answer, match the clue's target and specificity, and use true/false only when explicitly requested. These failures reflect not applying those rules or inconsistent answer-form choices, rather than a clear generalizable gap. No edit is warranted.
